purpose: Turn a speculative or cross-domain terminal proposition into a layered, symmetry-complete-for-scope, option-preserving and falsifiable research programme.
invariants: Layer membership is explicit and no cross-layer inference is implicit.
Every genuine choice retains at least two named alternatives, including rejected and dormant alternatives.
Symmetry means a declared object, action and status; shared notation alone is not a bridge.
The symmetry census is complete only for its declared scope and records an open frontier outside it.
Every necessary lightning-strike link has independent closure evidence and a falsifier.
Landscape value and terminal-claim closure are recorded separately.
Ranking orders attention only and never supplies truth, novelty, empirical or admission authority.
A failed link breaks the terminal strike but does not erase independently established upstream results.

requiredLayers.question: What are the objects, maps, identities and typing rules?
Where do inverses, limits, poles, positivity and regularity exist?
How do local patches, strata, bundles, indices and transition data fit globally?
Which groups, groupoids, involutions or covariance laws act, and what is preserved, broken, quotiented or anomalous?
Which observables, preparations, dynamics and conservation laws give the formal object physical meaning?
What representation, algorithm, conditioning and executable refusal rule realize the construction?
Which sources, derivations, counterexamples and replications support each link?
What authority, review stage, promotion rule and correction path apply?

phases.name: Bound the strike
phases.output: conditional terminal proposition, scope and authority boundary

phases.name: Separate layers
phases.optionPolicy: do not use a result in one layer as evidence in another without a typed bridge

phases.name: Census symmetries
phases.output: scope-bounded symmetry records and symmetry frontier
phases.optionPolicy: retain exact, approximate, broken, emergent, gauge and anomalous readings separately

phases.name: Expand option points
phases.output: alternatives with commitments, discomforts and re-entry conditions
phases.optionPolicy: no decision point may be represented by only the preferred alternative

phases.name: Build the lightning chain
phases.optionPolicy: branch rather than conflate inequivalent link mechanisms

phases.name: Choose discriminant portfolio
phases.output: baseline, uncomfortable, pressure-test and shared-discriminant calculations
phases.optionPolicy: expected plausibility is not the only priority

phases.name: Execute bounded strikes
phases.output: proofs, computations, counterexamples and refusal receipts
phases.optionPolicy: negative and singular cases are first-class outputs

phases.name: Reconcile without collapse
phases.output: updated layer ledgers, branch statuses and dependency changes
phases.optionPolicy: record equivalence, implication, analogy and physical mechanism as different edge types

phases.name: Triage
phases.output: retain, hold, no-go, retire, split, merge or re-root recommendation
phases.optionPolicy: human review remains distinct from corpus or application admission
